verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
verses.sm: Ua fai ifo le tagata valea i lona loto, E leai se Atua. Ua leaga lava i latou, ua inosia a latou amioga; e leai lava se tasi ua amio lelei.

verses.en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
verses.sm: Nasilas:la mai le Atua mai le lagi i le fanau a tagata, ina ia silafia pe ai se tasi ua poto, o se na te sailia le Atua.

verses.en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.sm: Ualatou taitasi ma foi i tua, ua leaga faatasi lava i latou; e leai se tasi ua amio lelei, e leai lava se tasi.

verses.en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
verses.sm: Eleoiloa ea o e fai amio leaga? ua latou aai i loʻu nuu, e pei ona latou aai i le mea e ‘ai; ua latou le valaau i le Atua.

verses.en: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
verses.sm: Ua latou matuā matatau i lea mea sa leai se mea e matatau ai; aua na faataapeapeina e le Atua o ivi o le na to lauapi mai ia te oe; na faamaina i latou, aua ua ʻinoʻino le Atua ia te i latou.

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.sm: E! fia Poa se na te aumaia le olataga o Isaraelu mai Siona. Pe a faafoisia mai e le Atua le tafeaga o lona nuu, ona olioli ai lea o Iakopo, e fiafia ai Isaraelu.
